products.title: HUILA SELECT - COLOMBIA
products.body_html:
VANILLA | MAPLE SYRUP | ALMONDS 

HUILA, COLOMBIA

Sourced through our friends at Sabores. A great option for espresso drinkers. If you enjoyed Nuevo Futuro in the past then this coffee is for you. Smooth, moreish and approachable. We are pouring this on espresso at both cafe's.

The Sabores Select Huila coffee comes from a collective of 63 small coffee farms in Colombia called Agua Azul. These producers cultivate 1-5 hectare farms in the villages of Palestina and San Adolfo in Huila. Led by Julio Gómez, Agua Azul sells its premium coffee every two weeks to our partners at origin, Clearpath, at above-market prices, supporting the group’s acclaimed specialty coffee production.

Producer: Small Holder Farmers 

Process: Washed

Altitude: 1350 masl

Flavour Notes: Cocoa Wafer, Maple Syrup, Almonds

Best for: Espresso

products.title: FINCA BARILLAS - GUATEMALA
products.body_html:
GRANDAILLA SHERBET | CARAMEL | VANILLA 

This coffee is a great starting point if you are beginning to experiment with different processes. Great body and lovely bright acidity. Overall, a smooth cup with balanced flavours. 

FRAIJANES, GUATEMALA 

Producer: Enrique Duarte

Process: Natural

Altitude: 1600 masl

Flavour Notes: Granadilla sherbet, caramel, vanilla 

Best for: Filter

products.title: LALESA - ETHIOPIA
products.body_html:
LEMON | EARL GREY | MILK CHOCOLATE 

A beautiful Ethiopian release. Classic notes of black tea and milk chocolate pair with a bright citrus acidity. A great option for pour over drinkers, especially V-60 and aeropress. For those who enjoy a lighter, fruit foward espresso these notes tranform into a creamy chocolatey cup with notes of peach and orange blossom. 

GEDEB, ETHIOPIA

Producer: Small Holder Farmers with Lalesa Washing Station

Process: Natural

Altitude: 2150-2200 masl

Flavour Notes: Lemon, Earl Grey Tea, Milk Chocolate 

Best for: Filter

products.title: AVATARA - INDONESIA
products.body_html:
PEACH YOGHURT | GUAVA | DARK CHOCOLATE

ACEH, INDONESIA

Another stunning release from Hendra and Team Pegasing. Bursting with tropical fruit  and decadent sweetness. A versatile coffee suited well to black filter but can also work as a funky espresso. 

Producer: Hendra Maulizar

Process: Anaerobic Natural 

Varietal: Gayo 1, Tim Tim

Flavour Notes: Peach Yoghurt, Guava, Dark Chocolate 

Best for: Omni

products.title: KINAMA HILL - BURUNDI
products.body_html:
STRAWBERRY, NOUGAT  | MILK CHOCOLATE 

A naturally sweet clean cup with great structure and a creamy body. Perfect for those who want to try a natural coffee without the intense funky flavours. Best without milk, but can be enjoyed as a 1:1 milk ratio. 

More About the Producer

Migoti Coffee Company is a specialty coffee producer and washing station based in the mountains of Burundi overlooking Lake Tanganyika.

Founded by Dan Brose and Poncien, it partners with thousands of local smallholder farmers to process high-quality Red Bourbon Arabica coffee, supporting community growth, renewable energy, and transparent global trade. 

Producer: Migoti Coffee 

Process: Natural

Altitude: 1665 masl

Flavour Notes: Strawberry, Nougat and Milk Chocolates 

Best for: Omni
